ui.note: task-79 ui_expectations.json (spec-dev) is the authoritative UI name list; this manifest exposes every UI Sprite/Texture found in the shipped asset files so the loader can name-match. TMP font assets: 22 Font objects exported as .ttf + atlas textures referenced by their material (2 font-atlas textures are not PNG-exportable).

gaps: SharedMaterial name on prefab SpriteRenderers is null in the shipped build (material PPtr is external); per-material properties are in materials/*.json keyed by material name.
Unity stripped Shader asset names: materials record `shader_<PathID>` (shader_resolution); a runtime plugin dump can map them to the shader names (BibiteSkin/background/zone/FOV).
22 font-atlas textures are not PNG-exportable by UnityPy (image_export_failed); the .ttf font bytes and the Font objects are exported, which is what the viewer needs for text.
Prefab components that are MonoBehaviour (Bibite, Zone, towers, effects) are unreadable without script typetrees; prefabs.json still records the readable Transform/SpriteRenderer hierarchy
